module.name: aws_eks_cluster_install_tmm_nads
module.description: Install Multus CNI and the two NetworkAttachmentDefinitions (ens7-ipvlan-l2 + ens8-ipvlan-l2) TMM needs for its data-plane interfaces. AWS EKS does not ship Multus by default; without this module a -with-hp-nodes deploy would need the F5 install guide's NAD YAMLs applied manually. Replaces that manual prerequisite. Designed to run after eks-cluster-hp-nodes and before eks-cluster-cneinstall in the variant blueprints.

required.reason: Provides the kubeconfig context for kubectl applies. Auto-wired via Forge's local.forge_kubeconfig injection.

optional.reason: Alternative upstream — emits the same kubeconfig output.
Logical predecessor — HP-nodes attaches the ens7/ens8 secondary ENIs that these NADs bind to. Wire as depends_on in the blueprint, not as a from_module input.

optional.name: install_multus
optional.description: Apply the upstream multus-daemonset manifest. Set false only if Multus is already installed on the cluster.

optional.name: multus_version
optional.description: Multus release tag. Default tracks a tested stable release.

optional.name: multus_manifest_url
optional.description: Explicit override URL for the multus-daemonset manifest. Empty = build from multus_version.

optional.name: nad_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where the NADs are created. Default 'default' matches the F5 install guide.

optional.name: nad_external_name
optional.description: External NAD name. Must match cneinstall's network_attachments[0].

optional.name: nad_external_master
optional.description: Host interface for the external NAD. Default 'ens7' matches hp-nodes external_eni_device_index=2.

optional.name: nad_internal_name
optional.description: Internal NAD name. Must match cneinstall's network_attachments[1].

optional.name: nad_internal_master
optional.description: Host interface for the internal NAD. Default 'ens8' matches hp-nodes internal_eni_device_index=3.

optional.name: nad_cni_type
optional.description: Multus CNI plug-in. F5 reference uses 'ipvlan'; on-prem may use 'host-device' or 'macvlan'.

optional.name: nad_ipvlan_mode
optional.description: ipvlan mode. Only used when nad_cni_type = ipvlan.

optional.name: nad_static_address
optional.description: Placeholder static address in the NAD ipam stanza. F5 IPAM operator manages real allocation; this value just satisfies the CNI schema.

key_outputs.name: multus_installed
key_outputs.description: Whether Multus was installed by this module.

key_outputs.name: nads_applied
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once both NADs are applied. cneinstall depends on this before rendering the CNEInstance CR.
